met_analysis:
The Deep Depression over north interior Odisha and adjoining areas of south Jharkhand & Chhattisgarh moved westwards with a speed of 07 kmph during past 6 hours, and lay centred at 0530 hrs IST of today, the 29th July 2026, over the same region, near latitude 21.9°N and longitude 84.0°E, about 10 km west-southwest of Jharsuguda (Odisha), 50 km north of Sambalpur (Odisha), 60 km east of Raigarh (Chhattisgarh), 100 km west-southwest of Rourkela (Odisha), and 190 km east of Bilaspur (Chhattisgarh). It is very likely to continue to move nearly westwards across north interior Odisha and north Chhattisgarh during next 24 hours.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes through Anupgarh, Pilani, Satna, centre of Deep Depressionover north interior Odisha and adjoining areas of south Jharkhand & Chhattisgarh, Puri, thence east-southeastwards towards Northeast Bay of Bengal.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over southwest Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over northwest Madhya Pradesh at 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over northeast Assam extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The Western Disturbance as a trough in middle & upper tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level now runs roughly along Long. 72°E to the north of Lat. 32°N.
